text:
harini: Quick flag on new reranker rnk-v5-ptq bring-up: overall NDCG is fine but top-1 MRR drops ~4% on docs that mix numbered lists + inline code + short tables.
oscar: Any minimal repro from holdout?
mei: Example (shortened):
query: "set up github pages custom domain"
fp16_doc: "1. create repo
2. enable pages
3. add CNAME file with `example.com`" -> rank 1
ptq_doc: "create repo and enable pages. Example CNAME `example.com`
See table: |env|note|
|gh-pages|use branch|" -> drops to rank 3 on int8
oscar: That's pretty similar textual content. Token counts differ?
harini: Yes. fp16 tokenized preserves separate backtick and dot tokens; ptq artifact tokenization shows merges like '`example.com`' -> single token. I attached a tiny diff.
gita: Could packaging have used a different tokenizer binary during quantization? We saw this before.
build-bot: :robot_face: queued job 5241234567-token-diff: ./tools/tokenizer_diff --model rnk-v5-ptq --slice lists_tables_code --samples 800 --out /tmp/td-5241234567
oscar: Also run a quick ablation: (A) add explicit sentence markers or spaces around backticks in preprocess, (B) run per-head calibration in PTQ, (C) try hybrid (attn fp16, rest int8).
mei: Running A and B locally on small shard. A (preproc spacing) recovers ~2.2% MRR; B (per-head calib) recovers ~3.1%. Hybrid recover ~3.6% in my quick runs.
harini: So preproc helps but doesn't fully close gap. Per-head calibration looks promising.
gita: Good. We should still fix tokenizer parity in packaging. If a tokenizer variant slipped into the quant worker, that causes nondeterministic merges.
build-bot: :white_check_mark: job 5241234567-token-diff completed. Found 19 tokenizer mismatches (mostly inline code and pipe-delimited table cells). Report: https://redwood.internal/tdiff/5241234567
oscar: Next steps: 1) pin tokenizer SHA in the quant packaging and fail if mismatch; 2) add a tokenizer-diff smoke in release pipeline; 3) run a per-head calibration sweep with stratified samples that include lists/tables/code; 4) curate a golden slice of 600 items (lists+inline code+tables) for onboarding CI with top1 MRR assert <= 1.5% vs fp16.
mei: I'll curate the golden slice and open a PR with metadata + a small runner. Tagging @oscar and @gita for review.
harini: I'll open the per-head calib PR and upload head-wise attention norm plots for the top mismatches. If certain heads collapse after per-tensor PTQ, that will show up.
oscar: Also add a lightweight normalization preproc to onboarding as a stopgap (space out backticks/pipes). Make it opt-in for now.
gita: Agree. Add a checklist update to onboarding docs: "tokenizer parity + formatting slices (lists/tables/code)" under quantization checks.
build-bot: :robot_face: queued job 5241234567-calib-per-head: ./quant --model rnk-v5 --calib per_head --samples 2500 --strata lists_tables_code=700 --out /artifacts/5241234567
ryan: One more ask: dump a couple of attention maps for a failure case so we can inspect positional alignments when tokens collapse. That helps confirm KV misalignment vs pure token merge issues.
mei: Will attach maps in the PR. Early dump shows head 4 magnitude drops in ptq vs fp16 for the failing cases.
oscar: Excellent. Once PRs land let's rerun full holdout and close the loop. If per-head calibs reliably fix it we'll adopt as default PTQ recipe for rerankers.
harini: Thanks all. I'll push the golden slice PR this afternoon and follow up here when CI runs.
